thread:
Kai: Hey team — prod-live Console streaming view shows a gap + negative tokens/sec for the 12:00-12:05 window. Customer reported billing/usage blips. Can someone take a look?
Maria: Opening an incident ticket now. Any recent deploys or infra changes?
Alex: No deploys in that timeframe. I spotted a consumer rebalance on ingest-cluster around 11:58 that aligned with the gap.
Greg: Can you paste raw rollup deltas? We need to see if aggregates went negative or if it's a display/rollup window misalignment.
Alex: Pasted snippet from the rollup service logs:
```
2026-03-16T11:57:58Z INFO  partition=12 offset=1849234 commit=1849234
2026-03-16T11:58:12Z WARN  consumer-group=ingest-prod rebalance triggered, assigned=[12,14,19]
2026-03-16T11:58:13Z INFO  partition=12 offset=0 commit=0 (rebalance reset)
2026-03-16T11:58:20Z ERROR rollup-window=2026-03-16T12:00 delta=-1200 total=3500
2026-03-16T12:00:21Z INFO  rollup-agg completed window=2026-03-16T12:00 total=2300
```
Alex: That delta=-1200 is the suspicious bit — the rollup service applied a negative delta after offsets jumped.
Maria: So the dashboard shows negative tokensec because the rollup subtracts a later smaller counter from an earlier larger one? That suggests out-of-order commit or checkpoint overwrote a larger offset with a smaller one.
Greg: Exactly. Either Kafka offset checkpointing wrote an older offset after rebalance or the rollup aggregator windowing mis-ordered events during partition move.
Alex: Quick repro suggestion: simulate a consumer rebalance on staging and watch rollup. I have a replay command I can run:
```
# simulate rebalance by restarting consumer shard
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingest-consumer --namespace prod-ingest --selector=shard=12
# then replay a captured segment to the rollup topic
./tools/replay_rollup.sh --topic streaming-rollup --from 2026-03-16T11:55 --to 2026-03-16T12:05
```
Maria: For customer comms — should we clamp the dashboard to zero floor for now so bills and charts don't show negatives?
Greg: Yes, add a frontend clamp and mark it temporary. Also schedule a backfill to re-aggregate the affected windows. I'll own the backfill job.
ingest-bot: Alert: consumer-group ingest-prod rebalanced at 2026-03-16T11:58:12Z (partitions reassigned).
Alex: Starting backfill job on infra-backfill-2 now. Command: `python backfill_rollups.py --window-start "2026-03-16T11:55" --window-end "2026-03-16T12:10" --threads 4` — ETA ~21m.
Maria: Created support ticket INF-3421, added initial notes and ESCALATED tag. Also added temporary billing note for affected customers.
Greg: Post-mortem action items: 1) add detection to disallow negative deltas during rollup (clamp at aggregation layer + log anomaly), 2) add unit/integration tests for rebalance scenarios, 3) audit checkpointing to ensure we never commit older offsets after rebalance, 4) dashboard safety clamp for display.
Alex: Found one potential bug in rollup aggregator: when partition reassignment writes a zeroed checkpoint before replay completes, aggregation sees a lower counter. I'll open a PR with a fix for how we merge checkpoint deltas (use last-known monotonic counter).
Kai: Thanks — keep updates in this thread. Once backfill completes, let's validate tokens/sec in Console and close INF-3421.
Alex: Backfill finished, re-aggregated windows show non-negative totals now. Dashboards updated.
Maria: Notifying affected customers and closing temporary billing note.
Greg: I'll follow up with the PR and tests, and schedule a short runbook for future rebalance events.
Kai: Great work, all. :thumbsup:
